diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/sentiment_service.py
@@ -0,0 +1,60 @@
+import os
+
+import torch
+from flask import Flask, jsonify, request
+from transformers import AutoModelForSequenceClassification, AutoTokenizer
+
+MODEL_DIR = os.environ.get("MODEL_DIR", "/app/model_cache/sentiment_model")
+
+if not os.path.isdir(MODEL_DIR):
+    raise RuntimeError(f"Model directory does not exist: {MODEL_DIR}")
+
+tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL_DIR, local_files_only=True)
+model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(MODEL_DIR, local_files_only=True)
+model.eval()
+
+app = Flask(__name__)
+
+
+def _sentiment_scores(logits):
+    probabilities = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1)[0].tolist()
+    scores = {"positive": 0.0, "negative": 0.0}
+    id_to_label = getattr(model.config, "id2label", {})
+
+    for index, probability in enumerate(probabilities):
+        label = str(id_to_label.get(index, "")).lower()
+        if "positive" in label:
+            scores["positive"] = float(probability)
+        elif "negative" in label:
+            scores["negative"] = float(probability)
+
+    # The SST-2 model uses the conventional NEGATIVE/POSITIVE labels.
+    if sum(scores.values()) == 0.0 and len(probabilities) == 2:
+        scores = {"negative": float(probabilities[0]), "positive": float(probabilities[1])}
+
+    return scores
+
+
+@app.post("/sentiment")
+def sentiment():
+    payload = request.get_json(silent=True)
+    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
+        return jsonify(error="Request body must be a JSON object"), 400
+
+    text = payload.get("text")
+    if not isinstance(text, str):
+        return jsonify(error="The 'text' field must be a string"), 400
+    if not text.strip():
+        return jsonify(error="The 'text' field must not be empty"), 400
+
+    inputs = tokenizer(text, return_tensors="pt", truncation=True)
+    with torch.inference_mode():
+        logits = model(**inputs).logits
+
+    confidence = _sentiment_scores(logits)
+    sentiment_label = "positive" if confidence["positive"] >= confidence["negative"] else "negative"
+    return jsonify(sentiment=sentiment_label, confidence=confidence)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    app.run(host="0.0.0.0", port=5000)
